run_ml_training_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with cross-validation and save prediction plots
run_ml_training_her: run ML model training on HER experimental data using linear or random forest regressors
run_ml_training_with_processed_df: run ML training by loading a preprocessed CSV dataframe instead of raw experimental and computational files
run_ml_training_with_el_features: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to the feature set for better predictions
run_ml_training_loo_cv: run ML training using leave-one-out cross-validation splits and generate scatter plots with R2 and MAE
